cli.label: Command line
cli.how: The quickstart on this page, run as printed from an empty home folder on macOS with the downloaded release ZIP, reached a USD 38 quote (23 November 2026).

claude_code.label: Claude Code (headless session)
claude_code.how: A fresh claude -p session (Sonnet 5.5) on macOS with no AAF skill or profile, given only the copied message, installed to ~/.claude/skills/aaf-agent and reached a USD 38 quote in three turns, with a test passkey approving in the browser (23 November 2026).

codex.label: Codex (headless session)
codex.how: A fresh codex exec session (gpt-6.2-sol) on macOS with no AAF skill or profile, given only the copied message, reached a USD 38 quote in three turns. Its sandbox refused writes to ~/.agents/skills, so it said so and installed in its workspace folder (23 November 2026).

claude_desktop.label: Claude Code in the Claude desktop app
claude_desktop.how: Pending verification: the app's own permission prompts, and replacing an older installed copy of the skill, have not been run end to end.

codex_desktop.label: Codex desktop app
codex_desktop.how: Pending verification: the app's own permission prompts and the default skills folder have not been run end to end.
